metadata.note: Real HCMC establishments from desk research on 2026-11-27. Facts are taken only from the cited sources; fields a source did not state are omitted. Status is 'unverified' = listed by a published source, not yet confirmed on site or by phone by the K's Experience team. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (ODbL); 'street' precision means only the street was matched.
